title: Build a marketing agent team in Claude Code
hook: I hired 3 marketing agents for $0 in salary

beats.say: I'm the founder, the marketer and the intern. Launch is Friday.
Hire an agency. Twelve grand a month.
Or build three subagents in Claude Code. Each one is just a markdown file with its own job.

panel.label: .claude/agents/researcher.md
panel.text:
---
name: researcher
description: Finds what competitors post and what our audience complains about.
tools: WebSearch, WebFetch
---
Return 5 angles nobody in our niche is covering.

beats.say: A researcher finds angles. A copywriter drafts. A critic tears it apart before you post.
Each gets its own context, so the critic can't go easy on the copywriter's work.

panel.label: You to Claude Code
panel.text: Use the researcher, then have the copywriter draft 3 launch posts from the best angle. Run the critic on each and only show me what survives.

beats.say: The critic rejected two posts. It was right.

cta: Follow for one Claude build a day
caption: A marketing team in Claude Code: three subagents, each a markdown file in .claude/agents/ with its own role, tools and separate context. Researcher finds the angle, copywriter drafts, critic rejects anything generic. Run /agents in Claude Code to create them. Comment AGENTS and I'll send all three files.
